font.reason: This is restrained enterprise/product UI. Vazirmatn is a loaded variable Persian UI sans with dependable joining, Persian punctuation, ZWNJ coverage and real weight variation for the title, list hierarchy and compact filters.

translation.scope: Translated all visible copy on both faces of the flipping panel: enterprise list title/subtitles, tabs, recency label, location/filter controls, filter groups, and old-page title/tags.
translation.copy_notes: Product and technical tokens remain Latin where appropriate and are visually isolated by the RTL browser shaping context. Persian uses ی/ک, ZWNJ in compounds such as بسته‌شده and ساخته‌شده, and idiomatic product wording. No Persian digit conversion was needed because visible numeric content is the Q3 label translated as فصل سوم.

rtlDecisions.what: Wrapped the composition in FaRoot with direction rtl and loaded Vazirmatn.
rtlDecisions.action: Applied RTL only to the UI/panel content; retained absolute map coordinates and SVG geometry.
rtlDecisions.why: The map, 3D card flip, camera movement, physical glow and pipe transport are motion/scene semantics, while the panel is reading-direction content.

rtlDecisions.action: RTL flex layout places the list on the right and the filter rail on the left; moved the separator to border-right and padding to padding-right. Icon/text rows inherit RTL so the colored marker sits at the reading-side edge.
rtlDecisions.why: This mirrors the source's product-information hierarchy for Persian readers without changing the panel's physical size or placement.

rtlDecisions.action: Mirrored the header row so the marker sits to the right of the Persian title and translated the three metadata chips.
rtlDecisions.why: The marker/title relationship is UI reading order; the page itself remains the physical front face of the existing 180-degree flip.

rtlDecisions.what: Figma, GitHub, Salesforce, GDrive and Dropbox vector marks plus colored connection pipes.
rtlDecisions.action: Kept vector marks, coordinates, pipe paths, pulse direction and phase offsets unchanged.
rtlDecisions.why: These are brand marks and physical network/map geometry, not text reading order; changing them would break source motion fidelity.

rtlDecisions.what: rotateY 0→180, four-frame bloom, map reveal, icon beat at 52f, pipe beat at 62f, nine-frame growth and continuous pulses.
rtlDecisions.action: No timing, easing, seed, duration, fps or transform values changed.
rtlDecisions.why: The source prompt identifies the uninterrupted fast flip with tail deceleration and two-beat synchronized connection as the card's identity.

rasterHandling.action: No raster or baked-in text assets are used. All brand marks are inline SVG/CSS vector shapes and were left intact.

verification.visualInspection: Viewed Persian and original pairs at every requested beat, including pre-flip, side-edge bloom, post-flip icon reveal, synchronized pipe growth and final transport state.
verification.timing: Persian copy length changed glyph widths but did not alter any animation beat or duration; the fixed panel geometry remains readable without clipping or wrapping.
